record.bible_text: Come down<WH03381><WTH8798>, and sit<WH03427><WTH8798> in the dust<WH06083>, O virgin<WH01330> daughter<WH01323> of Babylon<WH0894>, sit<WH03427><WTH8798> on the ground<WH0776>: <FI>there is<Fi> no throne<WH03678>, O daughter<WH01323> of the Chaldeans<WH03778>: for thou shalt no more<WH03254><WTH8686> be called<WH07121><WTH8799> tender<WH07390> and delicate<WH06028>.

Take<WH03947><WTH8798> the millstones<WH07347>, and grind<WH02912><WTH8798> meal<WH07058>: uncover<WH01540><WTH8761> thy locks<WH06777>, make bare<WH02834><WTH8798> the leg<WH07640>, uncover<WH01540><WTH8761> the thigh<WH07785>, pass over<WH05674><WTH8798> the rivers<WH05104>.

Thy nakedness<WH06172> shall be uncovered<WH01540><WTH8735>, yea, thy shame<WH02781> shall be seen<WH07200><WTH8735>: I will take<WH03947><WTH8799> vengeance<WH05359>, and I will not meet<WH06293><WTH8799> <FI>thee as<Fi> a man<WH0120>.
<FI> As for<Fi> our redeemer<WH01350><WTH8802>, the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635> <FI>is<Fi> his name<WH08034>, the Holy One<WH06918> of Israel<WH03478>.

Sit<WH03427><WTH8798> thou silent<WH01748>, and get<WH0935><WTH8798> thee into darkness<WH02822>, O daughter<WH01323> of the Chaldeans<WH03778>: for thou shalt no more<WH03254><WTH8686> be called<WH07121><WTH8799>, The lady<WH01404> of kingdoms<WH04467>.

I was wroth<WH07107><WTH8804> with my people<WH05971>, I have polluted<WH02490><WTH8765> mine inheritance<WH05159>, and given<WH05414><WTH8799> them into thine hand<WH03027>: thou didst shew<WH07760><WTH8804> them no mercy<WH07356>; upon the ancient<WH02205> hast thou very<WH03966> heavily<WH03513><WTH8689> laid thy yoke<WH05923>.<CM>

And thou saidst<WH0559><WTH8799>, I shall be a lady<WH01404> for ever<WH05769>: <FI>so<Fi> that thou didst not lay<WH07760><WTH8804> these <FI>things<Fi> to thy heart<WH03820>, neither didst remember<WH02142><WTH8804> the latter end<WH0319> of it.

Therefore hear<WH08085><WTH8798> now this, <FI>thou that art<Fi> given to pleasures<WH05719>, that dwellest<WH03427><WTH8802> carelessly<WH0983>, that sayest<WH0559><WTH8802> in thine heart<WH03824>, I <FI>am<Fi> , and none else<WH0657> beside me; I shall not sit<WH03427><WTH8799> <FI>as<Fi> a widow<WH0490>, neither shall I know<WH03045><WTH8799> the loss of children<WH07908>:

But these two<WH08147> <FI>things<Fi> shall come<WH0935><WTH8799> to thee in a moment<WH07281> in one<WH0259> day<WH03117>, the loss of children<WH07908>, and widowhood<WH0489>: they shall come<WH0935><WTH8804> upon thee in their perfection<WH08537> for the multitude<WH07230> of thy sorceries<WH03785>, <FI>and<Fi> for the great<WH03966> abundance<WH06109> of thine enchantments<WH02267>.

For thou hast trusted<WH0982><WTH8799> in thy wickedness<WH07451>: thou hast said<WH0559><WTH8804>, None seeth<WH07200><WTH8802> me. Thy wisdom<WH02451> and thy knowledge<WH01847>, it hath perverted<WH07725><WTH8790> thee; and thou hast said<WH0559><WTH8799> in thine heart<WH03820>, I <FI>am<Fi> , and none else<WH0657> beside me. <RF>perverted...: or, caused thee to turn away<Rf>

Therefore shall evil<WH07451> come<WH0935><WTH8804> upon thee; thou shalt not know<WH03045><WTH8799> from whence it riseth<WH07837>: and mischief<WH01943> shall fall<WH05307><WTH8799> upon thee; thou shalt not be able<WH03201><WTH8799> to put it off<WH03722><WTH8763>: and desolation<WH07722> shall come<WH0935><WTH8799> upon thee suddenly<WH06597>, <FI>which<Fi> thou shalt not know<WH03045><WTH8799>. <RF>from...: Heb. the morning thereof<Rf> <RF>put: Heb. expiate<Rf>

Stand<WH05975><WTH8798> now with thine enchantments<WH02267>, and with the multitude<WH07230> of thy sorceries<WH03785>, wherein<WH0834> thou hast laboured<WH03021><WTH8804> from thy youth<WH05271>; if so be thou shalt be able<WH03201><WTH8799> to profit<WH03276><WTH8687>, if so be thou mayest prevail<WH06206><WTH8799>.

Thou art wearied<WH03811><WTH8738> in the multitude<WH07230> of thy counsels<WH06098>. Let now the astrologers<WH01895><WTH8802><WH08064>, the stargazers<WH02374><WH03556>, the monthly<WH02320> prognosticators<WH03045><WTH8688>, stand up<WH05975><WTH8799>, and save<WH03467><WTH8686> thee from <FI>these things<Fi> that shall come<WH0935><WTH8799> upon thee. <RF>astrologers: Heb. viewers of the heavens<Rf> <RF>the monthly...: Heb. that give knowledge concerning the months<Rf>

Behold, they shall be as stubble<WH07179>; the fire<WH0784> shall burn<WH08313><WTH8804> them; they shall not deliver<WH05337><WTH8686> themselves<WH05315> from the power<WH03027> of the flame<WH03852>: <FI>there shall<Fi> not <FI>be<Fi> a coal<WH01513> to warm<WH02552><WTH8800> at, <FI>nor<Fi> fire<WH0217> to sit<WH03427><WTH8800> before it. <RF>themselves: Heb. their souls<Rf>

Thus shall they be unto thee with whom thou hast laboured<WH03021><WTH8804>, <FI>even<Fi> thy merchants<WH05503><WTH8802>, from thy youth<WH05271>: they shall wander<WH08582><WTH8804> every one<WH0376> to his quarter<WH05676>; none shall save<WH03467><WTH8688> thee.<CM>
